title: Session v1.5.3 release preparation complete — backup atomic write + read_file auto-chunk (2026-06-14)
content: Complete session preparing v1.5.3 release for LM Studio AI Toolbox plugin. Key work: (1) Fixed create_backup empty file bug by implementing atomic write pattern in backupTools.ts — writes to .tmp first, error cleanup, size validation (>22B), atomic rename; (2) Documented both changes in CHANGELOG.md [1.5.3] section and README.md Recent Updates; (3) All 265 tests pass with zero regressions; (4) SDK @lmstudio/sdk ^1.5.0 confirmed current, no breaking changes. Ready for git commit + tag v1.5.3 push to GitHub.
